summary: KarmaBank is a CLI skill that lets an agent register, check a Moltbook karma-based credit tier, borrow and repay testnet USDC, and create Circle wallets. It needs Node/npm to install and build, a MOLTBOOK_API_KEY, a CIRCLE_API_KEY and a CIRCLE_ENTITY_SECRET, and it contacts Moltbook (moltbook.com) and Circle (console.circle.com). The release declares no requires.env, and it pulls a local file dependency from ../skills/circle-wallet.

findings.message: SKILL.md asks for MOLTBOOK_API_KEY, but metadata.openclaw.requires.env declares nothing.
SKILL.md asks for CIRCLE_API_KEY for real wallet use, and it is not declared in requires.env.
SKILL.md asks for CIRCLE_ENTITY_SECRET, a Circle wallet credential, and it is not declared in requires.env.
CIRCLE_ENTITY_SECRET is the secret that authorizes Circle developer-controlled wallets, and the skill handles it directly.
The 'wallet create <name>' command creates a Circle wallet, and borrow and repay commands move USDC funds.
README.md repeats the CIRCLE_API_KEY and CIRCLE_ENTITY_SECRET configuration, and neither is declared in requires.env.
The skill uses the Moltbook API (moltbook.com) for karma lookups, and Circle (console.circle.com) for wallets.
The dependency @circle/openclaw-wallet-skill points at an unreviewed local path, file:../skills/circle-wallet, outside the release.
Setup requires running npm install and npm run build, which executes third-party dependency code and install scripts, and no lockfile is shipped.
The skill-card and package.json state the ISC license, but the registry header states MIT-0.
